subtitle: Discord Companion
emptyDescription: Install a presence from the library.
connectionDescription: Manage the connection between the extension, the native companion, and Discord.
marketplaceDescription: Install, update, or remove your presences from the Nowly library.
languageDescription: Use your browser's language by default, or choose a specific language for Nowly.
onboardingSubtitle: A quick guided setup to let Nowly communicate with Discord.
onboardingNonBlocking: You can continue using the panel while completing the setup.
onboardingStep1Body: Nowly uses a small native application to connect the extension to Discord RPC. It runs in the background and only receives the presence data required to update your activity. No personal data is collected.
onboardingStep2Body: Install and launch the native companion, keep Discord running, then connect. Once Discord is detected, your profile will appear here.
onboardingDiscordWaiting: Waiting for a Discord connection (make sure Discord is running).
onboardingStep3Body: Presences are installed and managed through the library. Each presence adds a detector for a supported website and can be enabled or removed at any time.
onboardingUserScriptsBody: Nowly installs presences using user scripts. This is a sensitive permission because it allows code to run on the websites you visit. To reduce risk, presences are digitally signed and verified locally before installation, and only the minimum activity data required is sent to the native companion to update your Discord status. Enable “Allow User Scripts” only if you understand and accept how this works.
onboardingUserScriptsHow: To enable it, open your browser's extensions page, select Nowly, and enable the “Allow User Scripts” option.
displayDescription: Choose how presences are organized in the list.
separateActiveDescription: Hides the active presence from the list.
apiBaseUrlDescription: Override the default API URL for self-hosted instances.
